content: विदारणः .²1 A tree or rock in the middle of a stream (to which a boat is fastened). .²2 War, battle. .²3 The Karṇikāra tree. .{@-णा@} War, battle. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Rending, splitting, tearing, ripping up, breaking, (often with the force of an <ab>adj.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); श्रुतं सखे श्रवणविदारणं वचः <ls>Mu. 5. 6</ls>; युवजनहृदयविदारणमनसिजनखरुचिकिंशुकजाले <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>; <ls>Ki. 14. 54</ls>. .²2 Afflicting, tormenting. .²3 Killing, slaughter.
